The [[Cratavian Empire]] Would Militarize heavily which Transformed and heavily fortified [[Vurahi|Vurahis]] infrastructure. This period of time marked a steep Decline for the city known as [[The Vurahi Dark Age]]. This period was marked by mass starvation, plague, and destruction of monuments including the [[1st Imperial palace of Vurahi|1st Imperial palace]]. The city would gradually recover over the century but wouldn't reach its previous level of prestiege until the [[Almaglean]] rule
